GAB.note: Document states nothing on a national data policy.
Digital sovereignty is named only as a general orientation of the ministry; no plan, rule or hosting stated.
Only the ministry's budget orientations are stated; no named national digital strategy.

facts.fact: Gabon's Ministry of the Digital Economy, Digitalisation, Innovation and New Technologies asked the National Assembly on 25 October 2026 for a 2027 budget envelope of FCFA 37,214,804,386, split between the programmes Digital Economy and Steering and Support of ICT policy.
facts.system: Ministry of the Digital Economy budget 2027

facts.fact: The ministry's requested 2027 envelope of FCFA 37.2 billion is about FCFA 16.5 billion below its 2026 envelope of FCFA 53,711,081,266.
facts.system: Ministry of the Digital Economy budget 2027

GAB.note: These are the budget estimates presented to the Assembly in the 2027 finance bill, not yet voted.
